title: Present Continuous for future arrangements
summary: Use Present Continuous for fixed personal arrangements in the future.

explanation.en: Present Continuous can describe a future arrangement when the time or plan is already fixed.
explanation.ru: Present Continuous может обозначать запланированную договорённость в будущем, когда время или план уже определены.

examples.en: I'm meeting Kate at six tomorrow.
examples.ru: Я встречаюсь с Кейт завтра в шесть.

examples.en: What are you doing this weekend?

commonMistakes.wrong: I meet Tom tomorrow at five.
commonMistakes.right: I'm meeting Tom tomorrow at five.
commonMistakes.note: Use Present Continuous for a fixed arrangement.
